observations: Both summary views show 54 fighters, 464 costumes, 35 additional appearances and 385 additional native PNGs, with 3,134 Production and 2,281 QA rows.

All 34 Production rows absent from the installed baseline were inspected: six recovered complete costumes, nine recovered preparations now complete, twelve later costumes, six props and the unresolved Maid Ribbit candidate.

The 21 QA rows absent from the installed baseline were inspected. CAST27-workbook correctly records the former blocked export as unexecuted; TRACKER28-reconciliation records this executed workbook pass.
All 29 appended references, the changed offline source and the displaced reference legend were inspected. Long URLs wrap without losing their contents.
Maid Ribbit remains marked À vérifier and does not increase the complete costume count.

An additional close inspection of the QA status area confirmed all repeated Réussi labels are visible in the original-resolution PNG; reduced inline preview scaling does not reflect missing workbook values.
limitations: Visual review of generated spreadsheet previews; no desktop Excel session or physical-device test is claimed.
